categories.main_business_segments: Daewon Cable Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of various types of cables including power transmission cables, insulated wires, communication cables, and automotive wires. The company and its subsidiaries focus on power and communication cables, with automotive wire production as a growing segment. Subsidiaries include Daemyung Cable, Weihei Jinwon Cable in China, and Daewon FMI specializing in automotive wire conductors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced cable manufacturing technologies including UL and KEPIC certifications for quality assurance. Production involves insulated and power cables using copper and aluminum rods as main raw materials, with continuous R&D efforts in flame-retardant, high-voltage, and automotive cable technologies. The company maintains high production capacity with modern facilities in Korea and China, emphasizing quality control and certification compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international construction companies, industrial power suppliers, telecommunications firms, and automotive manufacturers. The company serves both domestic Korean markets and export markets, including Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, China, and ASEAN countries. Major end markets are power transmission, industrial wiring, communication infrastructure, and automotive wiring sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Daewon Cable operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing plants in Yesan, Iksan, and Dangjin, and overseas production in Wendeng, Shandong, China. Sales and marketing offices are located in Seoul and regional offices across Korea. Export markets include Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, China, ASEAN countries, and other emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing cables from raw materials such as copper and aluminum rods procured from suppliers. It controls production and quality assurance processes and sells finished cable products to downstream customers including distributors, construction firms, and industrial users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding automotive wire production, enhancing product quality through certifications (UL, KEPIC, TRCU), and developing high-value-added cables such as flame-retardant and high-voltage cables. R&D focuses on new product certifications, cost reduction, and adapting to emerging markets like electric vehicles and renewable energy. The company invests in facility upgrades and innovation to maintain competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of manufactured cable products including power cables, insulated wires, communication cables, and automotive wires. Sales channels include direct sales to industrial customers, distributors, and exports. The company also earns revenue from processing and trading activities related to cable products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in the Korean cable industry include LS Cable & System, Daehan Cable, and Gaon Cable, which hold the largest market shares. Daewon Cable is positioned as a mid-to-upper tier player with a stable market share, focusing on quality and specialized products such as automotive wires to differentiate itself. The market is competitive with about 60 companies, but Daewon maintains a solid position among mid-sized firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Daewon Cable reported consolidated sales of approximately 515 billion KRW with an operating profit of 13.1 billion KRW and net income of 9.9 billion KRW. The company has a total asset base of about 243.9 billion KRW and equity of 100.3 billion KRW, maintaining a debt ratio of 134%. Despite a slight decline in sales compared to the previous year, profitability improved significantly due to cost control and stable raw material supply. The company shows steady growth with ongoing investments in automotive wire production.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daewon Cable emphasizes high-quality, certified cable products tailored for power transmission, communication, and automotive applications. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced R&D capabilities, extensive certification portfolio (UL, KEPIC, TRCU), and strategic investments in automotive wire manufacturing. The company offers reliable supply backed by stable raw material procurement and a broad domestic and international sales network, aiming to provide value through product innovation and cost efficiency.
